description.ja: GLMファミリーの起源となるモデル。100B級のオープンソースモデルとしてGPT-3を上回る性能を初めて実現。双方向Dense TransformerアーキテクチャとAutoregressive Blank Infilling目的関数を採用。ICLR 2023に採択。INT4量子化でRTX 3090×4での推論が可能。
description.en: The foundational model of the GLM family. The first 100B+ scale open-source model to surpass GPT-3 performance. Adopts bidirectional Dense Transformer architecture with Autoregressive Blank Infilling objective. Accepted at ICLR 2023. Supports inference on RTX 3090×4 with INT4 quantization.

specs.architecture: Bidirectional Dense Transformer (70 layers, 12288 hidden, 96 heads)

description.ja: フル精度版。96×DGX-A100で約60日間学習。
description.en: Full precision version. Trained on 96×DGX-A100 for approximately 60 days.
INT8 quantized version. Inference possible on A100 (40G×4).

description.ja: INT4量子化版。RTX 3090 (24G×4)または RTX 2080 Ti (11G×8)で推論可能。
description.en: INT4 quantized version. Inference possible on RTX 3090 (24G×4) or RTX 2080 Ti (11G×8).
